audience: teams that run invoicing and bookkeeping in Reviso Cloud Accounting

useCases.title: Chase overdue invoices by customer
useCases.text: List the overdue sales invoices with their remaining balance. Open the record of each customer to check the payment terms and the balance owed.

useCases.title: Look up a customer or supplier record
useCases.text: Search customers or suppliers by name. Read the address, VAT number, payment terms and VAT zone before you send an invoice or pay a bill.

useCases.title: Review the trial balance and ledger postings
useCases.text: List the accounting years, then read the total posted per ledger account for one year. Open the entries of one account to see each posting.

useCases.title: Create a draft invoice for an existing customer
useCases.text: Find the customer and the product numbers, then create a draft sales invoice with the quantities. The draft is not booked or sent: you review and book it in Reviso.

useCases.title: Add a new customer with the right reference numbers
useCases.text: Read the customer groups, payment terms and VAT zones in Reviso. Then create the customer. Search for the name first, because a second create makes a second customer.
